desc-c202.text: Important Locations in Jerusalem. This map outlines Jerusalem and labels the Temple, the Mount of Olives, and nearby places. Find Jerusalem inside the heavy black outline, then look across the blue river line toward the Mount of Olives.

desc-c197.text: Locations in the Book of Mark. The large blue area on the left is the Mediterranean Sea. Look inland to the pear-shaped blue lake just above the middle of the map. That is the Sea of Galilee. From its bottom, trace the thin, winding blue line down to the long blue Dead Sea near the bottom of the map. That line is the Jordan River. Blue lines mark rivers; dashed lines mark roads. Around the river are Galilee, Nazareth, Judea, and Jerusalem.
desc-c197.borrow: verbatim (PoC accepted description; V1-4 reviews length and passage fit)

desc-c201.text: Aerial View of Judea and Jerusalem. This illustrated terrain view shows hills and valleys around Judea and Jerusalem, with the Jordan River and the Dead Sea. Find Jerusalem and notice the raised land and the lower river valley as you picture the setting.
desc-c201.borrow: verbatim (PoC accepted description; V1-4 reviews length and passage fit)

desc-c168.text: Nazareth and Judea. Find Nazareth in the region labeled Galilee. Then follow the blue Jordan River toward the Dead Sea, and find Judea and Jerusalem. The black arrows are labeled travels of Jesus. Use these labels to orient yourself to Galilee, Nazareth, and the Jordan River area.
desc-c168.borrow: verbatim (PoC accepted description; V1-4 reviews length and passage fit)
